---
name: "Feature Request"
about: Suggest a new capability, enhancement, or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] {Insert your title here}"
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ["SteveLLamb"]
---

## Summary
Brief description of what you'd like to see.

## Rationale
Why is this important or useful?

## Implementation thoughts
If known, how it could be implemented (script, workflow, data, UI, etc.).

Helpful to name the surfaces involved, e.g.:
- registry data — `src/main/data/docs/**` (per-doc shards, via `src/main/lib/registry.js`)
- reports — `src/main/reports/masterSuiteIndex.json`, `src/main/reports/mri/` (via `src/main/lib/mriStore.js`)
- build / site — `src/main/scripts/build.js`, `src/main/templates/`, `src/site/`
- automation — `.github/workflows/`, `src/main/scripts/ci/`

## Acceptance
What has to be true for this to be done? (Checklist, if it helps.)

- [ ] 

## Related
Issues, PRs, docs, or upstream links.
